title: calendar
description: Days with marks: a habit’s weeks with a streak, a month with dated dots, or activity per day as intensity.

view.description: weeks: rows of seven days from `start` to `end` (one row is a single week). month: the month that contains `start`.

style.description: How marks are drawn: check (done, partial, missed), dot (labelled dots with a legend), intensity (`level` in five ink steps). Default: check for weeks, dot for month.

status.description: For check: done is an ink tile with a check; partial an ink outline with a grey check (“1 of 2 sessions”); missed a grey tile. A past day without a mark is “no record”, never missed.

level.description: For intensity: 0–1. 0 is a real zero (nothing happened); the client puts the rest in four ink steps. Leave an unknown day out.

label.description: For dot: the kind of mark, listed in the legend: Plans, Bill due, Deadline.

state.description: For dot: a state colour only when the mark means one (warning: something due; critical: a deadline). neutral is ink.

note.description: What the day holds, read by VoiceOver and shown when the day is tapped: “Dentist, 10:30”, “1 of 2 sessions”, “14 commits”.

items.description: One day’s mark. One per day for check and intensity; up to three per day for dot.

marks.description: The marked days, in any order. Days without a mark are drawn empty.

current.description: Days (or weeks) in a row, counted by the producer under the plan’s rules.

label.description: Overrides the words after the number: “day streak”, “weeks in a row”.

streak.description: The streak counter above the grid: “16 day streak · Best 21”. Sent by the producer; the client never computes it.
